summary.intent: Complete Phase 45 of the cipher-box project end-to-end through the full GSD workflow: plan, execute, verify, security audit, Nyquist validate, ship to PR, and resolve review comments. Phase 45 was a Rust-only FUSE write-journal/replay hygiene refactor (7 scope items, no behavior change) and was the final roadmap phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 fully closed across all GSD gates (plan → execute → verify → code-review → secure → validate). PR #491 opened, PR body fixed for GFM issue-reference collision, simplify cleanup applied (net −2 lines in journal_helpers.rs), CodeRabbit security finding fixed (file_key zeroize), and 2 pre-existing deferred issues logged as todos.

repo: Crate is `cipherbox-fuse` (feature `fuse`); workspace check command is `cargo check --workspace`; 266 total workspace tests as of Phase 45.

`publish_file_metadata` (operations.rs:125) pre-existed Phase 45 and was already called by the live release path; its conflict-swallowing behavior (`Conflict => warn + Ok`) is intentional pre-existing design, not a regression.
`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` is `pub use ecies::wrap_key` — a transparent re-export, so callers can and should prefer it over importing ecies directly.
The winfsp crate (`cipherbox-fuse/platform/windows`) cannot compile on macOS due to Windows-only deps (`winfsp-sys`, `windows_core`, etc.); the correct gate is Windows CI, not local cargo check.
`github-actions[bot]` may push a `chore(release)` commit onto a PR branch shortly after PR creation, requiring `git fetch && git rebase origin/<branch>` before subsequent pushes.
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo because it queries deprecated Projects-classic; the correct workaround is `gh api -X PATCH repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{N} -F body=@file`.

A stray `cargo fmt` on a new module (e.g., `journal_helpers.rs`) reformats the entire package, leaving out-of-scope files dirty in the working tree; prefer `rustfmt crates/fuse/src/journal_helpers.rs` to scope formatting to the changed file only.

`gsd-tools query commit` can return a false-negative `commit_failed` when the commit actually succeeds (lint-staged output is misread as an error body); always verify with `git log` rather than trusting the return value.

code.finding: File key zeroized here, but `generate_file_key()` returns plain `[u8; 32]` with no Zeroize-on-Drop, so the two `?` early-returns above `clear_bytes` leave raw key bytes in memory — applied zeroize fix on all error paths in this PR.

`resolve_ipns_for_replay` treats `PublishCoordinator::resolve_sequence` cache-fallback as `Found` — a transient/non-404 failure with a cached seq returns `Found(cached)` instead of `IpnsResolveOutcome::Error`, so replay continues rather than retaining the journal entry. Pre-existing behavior deliberately preserved by Phase 45 #19; deferred as todo.

`write_generation += 1` bump post-refactor (was :297 pre-refactor); the fuser/winfsp `write_generation` asymmetry is pre-existing platform design, not a Phase 45 regression — confirmed when verifying CR-02 false positive.

`publish_file_metadata` pre-existed Phase 45 here with conflict-swallowing (`Conflict => warn + continue`) already in place; the pre-refactor inline replay also swallowed conflict identically, making CR-01 a false positive.

workflow: rust-analyzer diagnostics can show stale E0308 errors (from executor mid-edit state) even when the committed tree compiles cleanly; always run `cargo check` / `cargo test` against the committed tree rather than trusting IDE error overlays.

Deep code reviewers can produce false-positive blockers when reasoning from partial diff context — e.g., conflating a per-file publish path with a different folder/bin publish path that has retry-and-retain semantics. Always verify claimed regressions against pre/post diff before accepting or rejecting.
Bare `#N` in GitHub PR descriptions auto-link as issue/PR references in GFM; wrap scope-item references in backticks (`` `[#11]` ``) to prevent auto-linking to nonexistent issues.

When verifying a claimed behavior regression, compare the pre-refactor inline code against the replacement function call — if the function pre-existed and was already used by the live path with identical semantics, the claim is a false positive.

Discard out-of-scope whole-crate formatter drift before final commit; committing it pollutes the phase diff and obscures the intended scope. Verify the committed tree (not working tree) before declaring a phase clean.

friction: GitHub connectivity timeout on first push attempt (transient network failure; succeeded on retry).
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo due to deprecated Projects-classic integration, requiring a REST API workaround (`gh api -X PATCH`) for every PR body edit.

Deep code reviewer raised 2 severity-blocker findings (CR-01: conflict swallowing, CR-02: write_generation) that were both false positives — required manual pre/post diff inspection to disprove, adding significant verification overhead.

45-06 executor's stray `cargo fmt` left 14 out-of-scope source files dirty in the working tree (formatting-only drift); had to be diagnosed, confirmed as formatting-only, and discarded before final commit.
Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0308 on `read_ops.rs:821` after 45-03, E0308 on `lib.rs:632` after 45-06) required running `cargo check` to confirm they were IDE cache artifacts, not real errors.
`gsd-tools query commit` returned false-negative `commit_failed` on the VALIDATION.md commit despite the commit succeeding; required `git log` verification to confirm.
Winfsp cross-check failed with unrelated Windows-only dependency build errors on macOS, requiring additional investigation to confirm the failure was environment-only rather than a code defect.

Source: CodeRabbit PR #491 Thread 3, `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs ~217-222`.

Empty `file_meta_ipns_name` (`Option::None`) publishes an empty `FilePointer` locator instead of skipping the locator publish. Pre-existing behavior (#18 preserved it); deferred as 'heavy lift'. Logged as todo at `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-replay-empty-file-meta-ipns-name-publishes-empty-filepointer.md`. Source: CodeRabbit PR #491 Thread 4.

Convert `spawn_bin_entry_publish`'s string-match not-found classification to use the new typed `IpnsResolveOutcome` enum — requirement #19 was deliberately scoped to replay only; the bin path uses a different resolve function. Deferred from /simplify.
Move `default_journal_dir` and `JOURNAL_MAX_RETRIES` from `crates/fuse` to `crates/sdk` — a cross-crate API move beyond the Phase 45 diff scope. Deferred from /simplify.

Atomicity of `update_status`, `Zeroizing` on plaintext fields, and `deser_opt_string` on `file_ipns_key_hex` — pre-existing minor warnings surfaced by the deep code review but outside Phase 45's scope.
Replay key-unwrap helper extraction in `lib.rs` — touches sensitive crash-recovery path; deferred rather than churn gated replay code in a cleanup pass.
Windows CI is the authoritative gate for the winfsp journal_helpers path; cannot be verified locally on macOS due to Windows-only dependencies.
